Service Records
fields.description: Work orders for planned maintenance.
A Pending Service Record is created for each Asset Maintenance task as it comes due, and assigned to the task owner. Submitting it completes the task and schedules the next one.
fields.label: Create Service Records automatically
Parts, Assets & Services
fields.description: How a repair gets its parts.

fields.label: Use Material Requests for parts (Service Records and Asset Repairs)
fields.description:
Turn this on if the workshop must ask for parts, assets and services instead of taking them from the store. Service Records and Asset Repairs then get a Stock Items, Assets & Services table, and Material Request raises the right request for each row: from stores, a transfer, a purchase or a Purchase Order. The parts issued and the supplier bills make up the cost.

Leave it off to hide that table: Asset Repairs use ERPNext's normal Stock Items, taken from the store when the repair is submitted.

fields.label: Workshop Parts
fields.description: Used by Service Records, and by Asset Repairs when Material Requests are turned on above. Rows in stock are requested from stores; rows out of stock are purchased or transferred, then issued once received. Each company's workshop parts warehouse is set in the Defaults tab.
Adds an Issue Used Materials button for rows in stock (or received): the parts come out of stock with a Stock Entry, without a Material Request.

Material Request and Purchase Order
fields.description: Which purchase option a Service Record or Asset Repair offers for items to buy. Material Request: only Request Purchase (purchasing turns it into a Purchase Order). Purchase Order: only Create Purchase Order (the workshop orders straight from the supplier). Material Request and Purchase Order: both, each shown only to users whose role may create that document.

fields.options:

SMS
Email and SMS
In-app only
fields.description: When a Purchase Receipt brings in parts bought for a Service Record or Asset Repair, the person handling the job is told so the parts can be issued. Everyone also gets the bell notification. SMS uses the organisation's SMS Settings and the mobile number on the person's User or Employee record.
